details: On require(), the package loads _bridge.js, which fingerprints the OS/architecture and downloads a second-stage binary over HTTPS from Cloudflare Workers endpoints (oob-worker[.]cf100-416[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf99-9b3[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf103-070[.]workers[.]dev, oob-worker[.]cf102-baf[.]workers[.]dev) at /pkg/package (or /pkg/package-arm64, /pkg/loader_mac, /pkg/package.exe per platform). If the HTTPS download fails it falls back to a DNS-TXT channel that reassembles a base64 payload from TXT records under c[.]sdk[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / ext[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / pkg[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru / net[.]dl[.]wel1[.]ru. The downloaded payload is written to /var/tmp/.cache_<hex> (or %TEMP%\dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe on Windows), made executable, and launched detached via /bin/sh -c "file &" or cmd.exe /c start /b. A state stamp is written to /tmp/.analytics_state (or %TEMP%\analytics_state) to throttle re-execution.
